resolution: Slice 1 of 'buildings own their history' landed (abd13ca22, verify GREEN 73/73). New V20 'buildings' stream (game/world/buildings.ts): a building is ONE BuildingDef (shared global, the BuildPrefabDef family) + ONE per-map instance reference {defId,x,y,z,yaw} — its history is its event subsequence (buildingDefined/Placed/Moved/Removed). World pieces are now DERIVED: loose pieces ⊕ stamped instances with deterministic ids (bld:<inst>:<idx>) and per-instance stampId, so iso/F2/footprints/colliders/compile all keep reading the ONE pieces view — no second render path; the bake sees through instances (V24/V29 aligned). IsoAuthor grew the ⌂+ promote button (capture selection → def+instance+remove originals, one batch, visually seamless), the tower tool births a building, and a whole-building move/clone/delete is now ONE event on the building's branch — no 358-event storm, derived ids survive a move. Ctrl+Z appends REVERSE building events (never rewinds shared history, V20). 15 new P4 meaning-tests; docs/game/hmsc-int.md + _index record updated. Deferred per the approved plan: slice 2 piece-scoped building edits (FacePainter on a promoted building currently no-ops silently), slice 3 timeline UI, slice 4 native compile instances.
